title: microchilus brachyrrhynchus
intro: Microchilus brachyrrhynchus, commonly known as the "Asian Barleria" or "Kadu", is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Microchilus brachyrrhynchus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, such as barlerin, barlerin, and kaempferol. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory distress.
